mean_cycle.scope: Whole 19-year cycles only; no entered-month or civil-date mapping, no later correction.

solar_recalculation.locator: T30107 canvas p20 left; p21 left; p22 right through left top
solar_recalculation.literal_heading: 就太陽曆求積年之歲差
solar_recalculation.scope: Reproduce two printed year coefficients and their products. The derivation of the recalibrated coefficient from the lunar/secular calculation is not accepted; arbitrary-year products are algebraic extrapolation only.

scope: Selected later mean/solar products, not the general +500 integer algorithm, complete secular correction, Tang epoch identification, civil-date conversion, daybreak or hourly sequence.
